title: Due to, owing to, consequently
summary: Nói nguyên nhân và kết quả: due to/owing to/because of + danh từ, since/as + mệnh đề, therefore/consequently/as a result.

dialogue.en: It was [[due to]] bad weather in Hanoi.
dialogue.vi: Do thời tiết xấu ở Hà Nội.

dialogue.en: Three hours. [[As a result]], I missed my meeting.
dialogue.vi: Ba tiếng. Kết quả là mình lỡ cuộc họp.

dialogue.en: [[Since]] you're tired, let's eat at home tonight.
dialogue.vi: Vì bạn mệt, tối nay mình ăn ở nhà nhé.

dialogue.en: Good idea. The flight was full; [[consequently]], I didn't sleep.
dialogue.vi: Ý hay. Máy bay kín chỗ, nên mình không ngủ được.

sections.heading: Due to, owing to, because of + danh từ
sections.rule: **due to / owing to / because of + danh từ (hoặc V-ing)** = do, vì. **Due to** hay đứng sau **be**: *The delay was due to…*

examples.en: The game was canceled [[due to]] the rain.
examples.vi: Trận đấu bị hủy do mưa.

examples.en: [[Owing to]] a lack of money, the project stopped.
examples.vi: Do thiếu tiền, dự án dừng lại.

examples.en: The delay was [[due to]] a technical problem.
examples.vi: Sự chậm trễ là do sự cố kỹ thuật.

sections.heading: Since, as, because + mệnh đề
sections.rule: **since / as / because + mệnh đề** = vì. **Since / as** thường đứng đầu câu cho lý do người nghe đã biết.

examples.vi: Vì muộn rồi, về nhà thôi.
examples.why: Since + mệnh đề, lý do rõ ràng.

examples.en: [[As]] she was ill, she stayed in bed.
examples.vi: Vì ốm, cô ấy nằm trên giường.

check.prompt: ___ you're here, can you help me?

sections.heading: Therefore, consequently, as a result
sections.rule: **therefore / consequently / as a result** = vì vậy, kết quả là. Đứng đầu câu mới (sau dấu chấm, chấm phẩy), có dấu phẩy. **So** dùng trong cùng câu, thân mật.

examples.vi: Cậu ấy không học. Kết quả là trượt.
Giá tăng; vì vậy doanh số giảm.

examples.en: It was late, [[so]] we took a taxi.
examples.vi: Muộn rồi nên chúng tôi đi taxi.

check.prompt: The road was closed. ___, we were late.
check.explain: Kết quả, câu mới → As a result.

mistakes.wrong: The match was canceled due to it rained.
mistakes.right: The match was canceled due to the rain.

mistakes.wrong: Because of he was late, he missed the bus.
mistakes.right: Because he was late, he missed the bus.
mistakes.why: Because + mệnh đề; because of + danh từ.

mistakes.wrong: He was tired, therefore he went to bed.
mistakes.right: He was tired. Therefore, he went to bed.

mistakes.wrong: Owing to the traffic was heavy, I was late.
mistakes.right: Owing to the heavy traffic, I was late.

mistakes.wrong: Since of the rain, we stayed home.
mistakes.right: Because of the rain, we stayed home.
mistakes.why: Since + mệnh đề, không có since of.

exercises.prompt: The train was late ___ a problem with the engine.
___ it was raining, we stayed inside.

options: Because of the noise, I couldn't sleep.
Because the noise, I couldn't sleep.

exercises.prompt: The event was canceled ___ to the storm.
answers: due

exercises.prompt: ___ he had no money, he walked home.
answers: Since
As
Because

exercises.prompt: Costs have risen. ___, we must raise prices.
answers: Therefore
Consequently
As a result

exercises.prompt: The delay was ___ to a strike.
answers: due

exercises.vi: Trận đấu bị hủy do mưa.
Vì muộn rồi chúng ta về thôi.

exercises.sentence: Due to he was sick, he didn't come.
answers: Because he was sick, he didn't come.

exercises.sentence: We were late because of the traffic was bad.
answers: We were late because the traffic was bad.

exercises.sentence: Owing the storm, the school was closed.
answers: Owing to the storm, the school was closed.

exercises.vi: Chuyến bay bị hoãn do sương mù.
answers: The flight was delayed due to fog.
The flight was delayed due to the fog.
The flight was delayed because of fog.
The flight was delayed because of the fog.
The flight was delayed owing to fog.
The flight was delayed owing to the fog.
exercises.explain: Due to / because of + danh từ.

exercises.vi: Anh ấy không ôn bài. Kết quả là anh ấy trượt.
answers: He didn't study. As a result, he failed.
He didn't revise. As a result, he failed.

He didn't study. Therefore, he failed.

He didn't study, so he failed.
